row.set_name: If that sounds crazy...I mean, you’re not wrong. But the same was also said about the regular 2025 NBA Chrome Sapphire release at a $1500 price point. Right before zero people scored it on EQL and it was instantly $3500-$4k/box. It also just so happened to be one of the most epic products of all-time.
